directions.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: missing FRONT camera view in a six-direction 360-degree Bible environment. Return one highest native resolution SQUARE image, a 104-degree rectilinear view, with fine cinematic photographic detail.
Input image 1: supporting ADJACENT LEFT-direction view of the existing world, showing Elijah and crowd. Input image 2: supporting DOWN-direction view from the same fixed camera, showing the wet trench, rocky ground and clay vessels. These are references for the same world, not the requested camera direction. Do not repeat their camera views.
Primary request: complete the missing FRONT direction by rotating the eye-level camera 90 degrees RIGHT from image 1, with NO camera translation, no change in time, style or scale. Eye height 1.65 metres on the rocky clearing of Mount Carmel, 1 Kings 18. Elijah from image 1 is immediately LEFT of the front direction and appears only partially cropped at the extreme LEFT edge; keep his exact dark-grey beard, brown patterned cloak and cream tunic, arms raised, no second Elijah. The altar is close and central, built of exactly TWELVE large natural unhewn stones, six in each of two courses, distinct joins and wet grain, low broad construction, damp wood on top. Fire from God has JUST reached the altar; a golden-white natural flame rises vertically from wet wood into the daytime sky, offering entirely hidden inside flame, no visible animal. The altar and wood remain soaked at this first instant. A continuous shallow water-filled circular trench surrounds the altar, plain water clearly visible with warm reflections and wet soil, not a stone fountain. The water and wet rocks continue the exact materials in image 2. FOUR dedicated rough hand-thrown earthenware water jars stand around the altar; keep positions consistent with any reference vessel in an overlapping edge, one may be tipped with spilled water. Behind the altar, the same kneeling and bowing ancient Israelite crowd in humble linen and wool garments, rocky dry upland slopes, shrubs, a distant blue Mediterranean coastal glimpse. Match the existing blue daytime sky, scattered clouds, warm flame reflections, period faces and worn sandals.
Continuity constraints: same fixed viewpoint and 104-degree perspective, horizon around mid-height, preserve scale and appearance of all overlapping people and props. Continue the reference edges naturally; show altar, trench and water jars as the front story clues, no unrelated new architecture. Maximum microscopic detail: wet limestone grain, clay pits, rope fibres, cloth weave, skin, clear water ripples and wood cracks. Natural photographic realism.
Avoid: extra Elijah, additional near-altar water jars, dozens of little altar stones, lamb or sheep, visible bull, blood or slaughter, modern buckets, metal railings, fountain, church, cross, dome, fantasy temple, modern objects, text, labels, UI, watermark, frame, collage, circular/fisheye projection.

base.prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: repaired equirectangular panorama source for a spherical 360-degree viewer.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, a derived Mount Carmel panorama. This is one full 360-degree by 180-degree equirectangular image, 1774 pixels wide by 887 pixels high. Return the whole same 2:1 panorama at 1774x887, not a camera crop.
Primary request: repair ONLY the visible compositing artifacts in this supplied panorama. Keep the existing scene, camera location, projection, view directions, scale, people, colors and day lighting. Preserve Elijah raising his arms at the left of the low stone altar, the LOW altar made from TWELVE unhewn stones in TWO courses of six, the damp stacked wood, vivid golden-white fire, the water-filled trench with coherent reflections, and exactly FOUR earthenware water jars around the altar. There must be no added altar or second Elijah.
Observed defects to repair: at the overlap joins about one eighth and three eighths of the way across the image near the altar sides, some people, jars, stones and water reflections are doubled, translucent, or abruptly clipped. Make each existing person and jar a single solid coherent object in its retained position. Remove only the ghost duplicate outlines. Preserve the four real jars: the near upright jar on the left, the tipped jar by the right side of the altar, the tipped jar in the right foreground, and the upright jar farther right. Continue the water trench, ground, crowd and coastline smoothly through these joins. There is also a break in the rising flame/plume between the central front view and the upper sky view. Make one naturally continuous plume from the existing altar fire upward into the existing pale golden cloud; remove the thin detached ghost column just right of the altar. Keep the same large blue sky, irregular clouds, and Mediterranean coastline.
Spherical continuity: left and right image edges show the same back direction and must join seamlessly when wrapped. Preserve equirectangular distortion; do not create a normal wide photograph. At the very top and bottom rows, maintain smooth pole continuity without radial wedges or a starburst. No horizon shift.
Historical accuracy: ancient Israelite wool and linen tunics, headwraps and sandals, rugged Mount Carmel, natural clay and wet limestone. No visible sacrificed animal.
Style: natural cinematic photographic realism, sharply resolved cloth, clay, stone, water and human detail, consistent natural warm daylight and fire glow.
Constraints: change ONLY join/ghost/plume artifacts; keep all retained scene content and the low twelve-stone altar, exactly four water jars, Elijah, wet trench and crowd. Do not add swords, architecture, additional jars, additional prophets, blood, modern items, text, labels, UI, borders, collage or watermark.
